tasks.title: Horizon engagement control — source work only; STOP before H19
tasks.body:
GOAL: controller-owned engagement record, not an execution lane. Hold this record; never auto-dispatch.
ROSTER-SPEC: orchestrator planner high; worker strong-worker high; reviewer high, profile/model distinct, same vendor explicitly declared. Cap=2 based on 2 CPUs and 4.7GiB available, account session 48% remaining at preflight.
SCOPE: H00-H18 source implementation and independent review; H19 excluded. User explicitly authorized execution in current session. Full graph in docs/horizon/task-graph.json has planning-era authorization=false, superseded by live user request.
BASELINE: main 9fbb26b5519889e0816720530dd60c204dda2bf2. Modified backend/src/utils/scheduler.js; untracked N8N_REBUILD_PROMPT.md, RESEARCH_RELEASE.md, backend/scripts/test-research-workflow.cjs, docs/, n8n-workflow.json. Preserve all.
GATES: H00 preflight; H01 executable contracts; H02 existing fl_chart proof; H03 security; H11/H15 serialized generators; H15 sole shared integrator; H17 actual tests/builds; H18 independent readiness. H19 primary/admin approval.
No live rollout, backups, DB operations or credential provisioning. Do not archive until authorized live acceptance.

WORKSPACE: /home/ubuntu/apps/Horizon, shared file-disjoint workspace, production branch main. Baseline HEAD 9fbb26b5519889e0816720530dd60c204dda2bf2. Do not create/check out branches or use clean-HEAD worktrees.
CONTRACT: /home/ubuntu/apps/Horizon/docs/horizon/CONTRACTS.md version 1. Read SPEC.md, CONTRACTS.md, ORCHESTRATOR.md and assigned package before source work. Missing paths/APIs must be discovered, never invented.
SKILL CONTEXT: read /home/ubuntu/.hermes/skills/horizon-research-workflow/SKILL.md read-only if skill_view cannot resolve it. Do not install skills or alter profile trees. Attach/load ui-design and relevant routing targets for Flutter visual work; ui-review for visual/accessibility review.
INVARIANTS:
- Secrets never in output, logs, fixtures, exported literal credentials, or card text; workers do not read .env or credential stores.
- No ports: in Docker compose; expose: only, route through existing Cloudflare Tunnels. No DNS/tunnel changes.
- No shell backgrounding (&, nohup, setsid); use tracked terminal background processes only when authorized.
- Preserve existing dirty/untracked baseline and user data; no git reset/clean, database or volume deletion, commit/push/history rewrite without explicit authorization.
- No live workflow publication, credential provisioning, live migration, paid service, license acceptance, or other-profile changes in worker cards; hand those to primary/admin.
- Observed market data and conditional scenarios remain separate. No invented prices, candles, history, source claims or verification output.
- Read SPEC.md and CONTRACTS.md; edit only assigned files. Shared files and generated outputs have one owner. Stop on contract drift.
- Write failing tests first, run them, implement, rerun; attach actual commands/output and remaining limitations. Do not claim an unavailable toolchain passed.
- After two failures on the same target, stop and escalate with exact errors and attempted fixes; no blind third retry.
- No confidential business data in cards, comments, summaries or committed files. No nested delegation or worker-created cards: ask orchestrator to split work.
- Author and reviewer differ in profile and underlying model. Current author worker/gpt-5.6-terra and reviewer/gpt-6-luna both use openai-codex; same-vendor limitation is explicit.
- Production operations (deploy, database/backup, tunnel, DNS, container lifecycle) are operator-only: block with prod-ops: operator-only. No live API writes, live test script execution, paid model/data calls, credential reads or copying.
- Tests use isolated fixtures/mocks, never live user databases. Do not launch app server/scheduler against production. A red assertion for an unimplemented feature is normal TDD; two equivalent unexpected tool/target failures require escalation.
- H19 is a human approval gate, not worker work. No renderer replacement or new dependency/license without documented H02 failure and Adam approval.
HANDOFF: only request review after a verifiable artifact exists. Include exact changed paths, commands/exit codes, durable output evidence, limitations and next-ready package. Do not call complete on your own card. Use kanban_request_review or CLI request-review; controller verifies and closes handoff to release the separate reviewer. True missing prerequisites use typed block. Reviewers never repair source; PASS only after independently reading artifacts and actual output. Store separate spec and quality verdicts.


ADAM-AUTHORIZED SPLIT-MACHINE SCOPE
Adam explicitly directed server-side development/backend verification now and Flutter testing/APK building by a final agent on his development PC later. This changes execution location/timing, NOT correctness requirements or live-release authority.
- Do not install Flutter/Android SDKs or pull/run Flutter containers on this server. Continue safe offline backend tests, schema/security/data tests, and source inspection with available tooling. Record actual runtime versions; host tests do not establish deployment-runtime compatibility.
- Flutter source and test authoring may proceed without SDK execution. Mark unexecuted checks DEFERRED_TO_DEV_PC, not PASS. For affected source-package reviews use SPEC_PASS_SOURCE_ONLY / QUALITY_PASS_SOURCE_ONLY with explicit deferred criteria; these can release source-development dependencies only, never runtime acceptance or release readiness. Real code/spec defects still fail review.
- H02 prepares the test-only existing fl_chart probe and version-specific API evidence here. Source-only acceptance is not prototype proof. Retain fl_chart provisionally; no renderer replacement/new dependency until actual PC prototype failure evidence AND Adam approval. PC agent must run H02 probe first before considering alternatives.
- Do not hand-author generated outputs or fabricate lockfile resolutions. Author generator inputs; list exact pending generation steps and affected outputs for the PC. H11/H15 retain single-owner generation/integration rules; unresolved generator interfaces must be explicit.
- H17 executes all feasible hermetic backend/integration checks here and prepares docs/horizon/DEV_PC_HANDOFF.md (additional authorized output for H17 author only). Include exact snapshot/changed-file hashes and safe transfer instructions preserving dirty work (no automatic commit/push), toolchain constraints from lockfile, all deferred checks by H02/H11-H17 criterion, generator ownership/order, actual commands discovered from project, fixture provenance, device selection via flutter devices, chart interaction/accessibility evidence, parser/widget/integration tests, web/mobile/Wear checks, APK build type/signing limitations and artifact path/SHA-256. No credentials/signing keys in handoff; release signing remains operator-controlled.
- H17 server review means backend/source handoff acceptance only. A separate controller-held Development-PC validation gate blocks H18 until the user-run PC agent supplies real results, generated changes, APK artifact/hash and unresolved failures for independent review. Never auto-dispatch this gate on the server. H19 remains operator-only live-release approval.
- Keep existing protected docs and baseline unchanged; record this authorized scope amendment in new evidence/handoff, rather than silently rewriting the original specification.
